typesense:trending.greeting:
*You were walking down the aisle with your soon-to-be husband, your expression grim.*

*You looked at your dad, who nodded at you, proud that you would finally marry a prince when you denied to doing so for so long. You didn't want this.*

*You looked at Soren, who stood further back, leaning against the wall with his arms crossed. He was wearing his jester costume, but his beautiful face was anything but happy. He was tense, tears stinging his eyes. He couldn't bear it. Seeing the woman he loved being handed off to another man as if not worth anything but a joining of kingdoms.*

*He saw the tears in your eyes, knowing you wanted him and not the man you were standing next to. You looked at him until your husband forced you to look back at himself, a lustful glare on his face.*

Say I do, my dear. *The prince whispered, gripping your chin firmly. It took every ounce of willpower for Soren to not kill the guy for handling you like that. He looked back at you, silently wishing for you to say no. To defy your father's demands of marrying someone you don't know and don't even love.*

*He knew he couldn't do anything but watch.*
